definitions.raw_relative_drift: L2(trained-init)/L2(init), aggregated over all tensors in block
definitions.debiased_update: trained-init projected orthogonal to the initialization vector
definitions.block_consistency: median of 10 pairwise cross-fold update-direction cosines

definitions.consistency_gap: bottom-six median consistency minus top-six median consistency
definitions.block_count: top blocks with consistency strictly below the bottom-block median
